
{{alias}}( arrays )
    Computes the number of non-`NaN` elements in a one-dimensional double-
    precision floating-point ndarray.

    If provided an empty ndarray, the function returns `0`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    arrays: ArrayLikeObject<ndarray>
        Array-like object containing a one-dimensional input ndarray.

    Returns
    -------
    out: integer
        Number of non-`NaN` elements.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/vector/float64}}( [ 1.0, -2.0, NaN, 2.0 ] );
    > {{alias}}( [ x ] )
    3

    See Also
    --------
